Portfolio update and Notice of Results | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Portfolio update and Notice of Results Summary by AI BETA Close X Molten Ventures realised circa £50m further from its Revolut holding, bringing Revolut realisations to circa £180m to date and delivering a c.21x multiple on invested capital; the firm reported a Revolut fair value of £175m at 31 March 2026, realised c.£70m in the first half of FY27, and expects a 30 September 2026 fair value of c.£130m after this sale. The transaction raises total realisation proceeds in the financial year ending 31 March 2027 to more than £150m, strengthens cash available for reinvestment, and precedes half-year results and investor presentations on 24–27 November 2026.
